/startup.description: Bring up local Marcos OS services needed for development, per .context/current.md.
reads: HANDOFF.md + PROJECT_STATE.md (fallback if context file missing/stale)

/feature.description: Implement the one approved feature currently defined in NEXT_TASK.md.

/bug.description: Diagnose and fix a single reported bug.

/review.description: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and security issues.

/document.description: Sync PROJECT_STATE.md, HANDOFF.md, and NEXT_TASK.md with completed work.

/handoff.description: Close out the current session — verify, document, and report.
reads: acceptance criteria of the current task
